SCENARIO "1.2026DownedPilot" {
  type: extraction
  difficulty: moderate
  teams: 1
  players: 2-4
  actors: 2-3
  duration: 90-180min
  public_sensitivity: moderate
  description: "Downed pilot behind enemy lines. Client infiltrates, links up with foreign agent (spy), solves dead drop, and assists in rescue/extraction of downed pilot."
}

LANE ALPHA {
  label: "INFIL / First Contact"
  status: safe
  beats: [1]
  notes: "Downtown Sandpoint. The District venue. Client-visible, moderate public traffic."
}

LANE BRAVO {
  label: "DEAD DROP / Reconnaissance"
  status: neutral
  beats: [2]
  notes: "Long Bridge walking path. Semi-isolated. Pre-stage canister under bench."
}

LANE CHARLIE {
  label: "EXFIL / Final Rendezvous"
  status: safe
  beats: [3]
  notes: "Schweitzer Mountain venue. Final link-up point. ENDEX location."
}

# ── BEAT 1: Initial Personal Meet ──────────────────────────────────────────

OBJECTIVE beat_1 {
  type: meet
  lane: ALPHA
  description: "Initial Personal Meet (PM1) — link up with IC (spy)"
  location: '"The District" – 313 N First Ave., Sandpoint, ID 83864'
  when: TBD
  actor: "IC (Spy / Foreign Agent Liaison)"
  engagement_level: 3

  bonafides: {
    challenge: "I've always favored an Old Fashioned in Paris."
    response:  "I usually prefer champagne in the city of lights."
  }

  detail: |
    IC is in position at The District in period-appropriate dress.
    Client(s) approach IC and issue challenge bonafide.
    IC confirms with response bonafide.
    IC delivers verbal briefing:
      - Scenario background (downed pilot situation)
      - Instructions for finding the dead drop at Long Bridge
      - General area / clue for the canister location
    IC acts "spooked" toward end of meeting — becomes nervous,
    makes excuse to depart early (fear of surveillance / capture).

  ic_notes: |
    Stay in character at all times. Use period-appropriate mannerisms.
    Deliver clue naturally (not as a briefing — as a hushed conversation).
    ENDEX cue from IC: check watch, say "I've said too much. I must go."
    Do NOT break character even if client seems confused.

  success: -> beat_2
  fail: -> actor_intervenes
  recovery: -> ic_delivers_note_fallback
}

ESCALATION phase_beat_1 {
  trigger: objective_complete(beat_1)
  tension: +15 on ALPHA
  actor_behavior: engagement_level 1
  event: surveillance_amber
}

# ── BEAT 2: Dead Drop — Long Bridge Canister ───────────────────────────────

OBJECTIVE beat_2 {
  type: retrieve
  lane: BRAVO
  description: "Dead Drop (DD) — recover waterproof canister at Long Bridge"
  location: "Long Bridge (Bonner County) — park bench along walking bridge, middle section"
  when: TBD
  actor: ""
  engagement_level: 0

  dead_drop: {
    container: "waterproof canister"
    placement: "under wooden park bench, walking bridge middle section"
    contents: "paper code or clue pointing to next link-up / extraction point"
    difficulty: medium
    pre_staging: "IC or handler pre-stages before scenario start"
    recovery_note: "If canister is missing/moved, IC handler activates alternate_drop_bravo"
  }

  detail: |
    Client(s) must decode the verbal clue from PM1 to locate the correct bench.
    Once canister is found and opened, client reads the clue inside.
    Clue directs them to the final rendezvous location (Beat 3).

  success: -> beat_3
  fail: -> alternate_drop_bravo
  recovery: -> actor_delivers_hint
}

ACTOR_SCRIPT alternate_drop_bravo {
  when: dead_drop_not_found AND time_elapsed(30min) AND beat_2_active
  do: IC or handler sends text/call hint: "Try the second bench from the lamppost"
  engagement_level: 0
  then: HOLD
}

ESCALATION phase_beat_2 {
  trigger: objective_complete(beat_2)
  tension: +30 on BRAVO
  actor_behavior: engagement_level 1
  event: surveillance_sweep
}

# ── BEAT 3: Rendezvous & EXFIL of Downed Pilot ────────────────────────────

OBJECTIVE beat_3 {
  type: escort
  lane: CHARLIE
  description: "Rendezvous & EXFIL — link up with downed pilot at Schweitzer Pub"
  location: "Schweitzer Pub @ Schweitzer Ski Resort (exact venue TBD)"
  when: TBD
  actor: "IC (Downed Pilot) + Hostess / Waitress (secondary IC)"
  engagement_level: 3

  bonafides: {
    challenge: "[TBD — assigned at final briefing]"
    response:  "[Hostess confirms with bona fide + provides final instructions]"
  }

  detail: |
    Client(s) arrive at Schweitzer Pub.
    Client approaches hostess/waitress with bonafide challenge.
    Hostess confirms and provides final instructions to locate downed pilot IC.
    Client links up with IC (downed pilot) at designated table/location.
    Client delivers key item / information:
      - Car key, OR
      - Train schedule info (how downed pilot can escape enemy territory)
    IC (downed pilot) acknowledges, thanks client, departs naturally.
    ENDEX declared by M.

  ic_notes: |
    Downed pilot IC should appear distressed but composed.
    Accept the key/info with relief, but remain in character.
    Depart naturally (not dramatically). Do not signal ENDEX to other patrons.

  success: -> ENDEX
  fail: -> actor_intervenes
  recovery: -> m_override_direct_linkup
}

EXTRACTION convergence {
  trigger: objective_complete(beat_3) OR m_override OR escalation >= 5
  rally: CHARLIE
  mode: clean
  endex: true
  notes: "M declares ENDEX via Ops terminal or phone call to IC lead."
}

ESCALATION phase_beat_3 {
  trigger: objective_complete(beat_3)
  tension: +60 on CHARLIE
  actor_behavior: engagement_level 3
  event: extraction_initiated
}

# ── ESCALATION CURVE ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# phase 0 — calm        : Pre-scenario. Client receives online brief.
# phase 1 — awareness   : Beat 1 active. IC in position. Clients INFIL.
# phase 2 — contact     : Beat 1 complete. Bonafides confirmed.
# phase 3 — pressure    : Beat 2 active. DD hunt. Clients tested.
# phase 4 — collapse    : Beat 3 active. Final approach. Tension peaks.
# phase 5 — extraction  : Beat 3 complete. ENDEX.

# ── ACTOR SCRIPT MATRIX ───────────────────────────────────────────────────

ACTOR_SCRIPT ic_spy_pattern {
  role: "IC (Spy / Liaison)"
  home_lane: ALPHA
  mobility: ALPHA only
  fallback_role: "Normal patron — disengaged"

  when: players_stalled(15min) AND beat_1_active
  do: IC subtly re-approaches client, drops verbal hint
  engagement_level: 2
  then: HOLD

  when: escalation >= 3
  do: IC increases urgency of departure cue
  engagement_level: 3
}

ACTOR_SCRIPT ic_pilot_pattern {
  role: "IC (Downed Pilot)"
  home_lane: CHARLIE
  mobility: CHARLIE only
  fallback_role: "Normal pub patron"

  when: beat_3_active AND players_stalled(20min)
  do: Hostess IC approaches client proactively (covers as "Can I take your order?")
  engagement_level: 2
  then: HOLD
}

# ── EVENT INJECTION DECK ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

EVENT_DECK downed_pilot_events {

  # Surveillance
  surveillance_amber: {
    category: Surveillance
    description: "M observes player hesitating near IC — inject a 'tail' (another IC walks past slowly)"
    trigger: m_decision OR time_elapsed(10min) AND beat_1_active
  }
  surveillance_sweep: {
    category: Surveillance
    description: "Tension increase — M injects 'security presence noticed' via player phone hint"
    trigger: m_decision
  }

  # Intel
  hint_redirect: {
    category: Intel
    description: "IC or handler sends indirect hint via pre-written note or text"
    trigger: players_stalled(15min)
  }
  false_clue_decoy: {
    category: Intel
    description: "A second (decoy) bench note misdirects briefly — adds tension without blocking progress"
    trigger: m_decision AND beat_2_active
  }

  # Pressure
  time_pressure_warning: {
    category: Pressure
    description: "M sends player a 'window closing' message — IC will not be available after [time]"
    trigger: m_decision AND time_elapsed(45min)
  }

  # Environmental
  venue_early_close: {
    category: Environmental
    description: "Pub closing early — M advances timeline if needed"
    trigger: m_decision
  }

  extraction_initiated: {
    category: Environmental
    description: "M broadcasts ENDEX to all actor devices"
    trigger: objective_complete(beat_3)
  }
}

# ── FAILURE & RECOVERY ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

RECOVERY ic_delivers_note_fallback {
  trigger: bonafides_failed OR players_confused
  action: IC passes folded note to client: "Be at the bridge by [time]. Look beneath the planks."
  notes: "Keeps scenario alive if client misses verbal bonafide exchange."
}

RECOVERY actor_delivers_hint {
  trigger: dead_drop_not_found AND time_elapsed(20min)
  action: IC or handler sends indirect hint — coordinates, riddle, or directional clue
}

RECOVERY m_override_direct_linkup {
  trigger: beat_3_active AND players_stalled(25min)
  action: M sends IC (pilot) direct instruction to approach client proactively
  engagement_level: 3
}
